Name: Waterfall Reversion For SVE
Author: Niteslash
Description:
[b]Reverts the waterfalls on [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] [b]& the optional but highly recommended Grandpa's Farm to their original appearance for vanilla colours.[/b]

If you're looking for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url] version, you can check out my other mod[b] [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7613]here[/url].

[b]Changelog:

1.1     -    [/b]Fixed tiles not changing to reflect seasons. (Thanks, Poltergeister.)
[b]1.0     -    [/b]Initial release.

[b]Installation:[/b]

Unzip the folder into your [b]Stardew Valley\Mods\[/b] folder
